title: Review the encoded many-axis production_axis guard.
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Scoped interface review. No new κ and no selected-frontier change. Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

`TensorPlan.production_axis` is three strict predicates on Counts that `__init__` has already loaded: `4 d g > s`, `(2d-1) g < s`, and `s > 2 (target_halo + 2 w)`, where `g = t - s`. The method's only `self` fields are `d`, `target_halo` and `w`. Its four `multiply_small` constants are `4, 2, 2, 2`. It names no tape operation.

On the PR #4029 band `I(t,d) = (t(1-1/(3d)), t(1-1/(4d))]`, every real point meets both ratio predicates. For `d >= 2` it also meets the near-one gate `s < t < 2s` that `__init__` checks before the call. Oddness is a separate gate: `s = 14`, `t = 16`, `d = 2` is in the band, passes both ratios, and is even.

If `K = target_halo + 2 w <= 2^(ell-3)`, every integer in the band on either target scale satisfies `s > 2K`. The witness `s = 939`, `t = 1024`, `d = 4`, `target_halo = 470` passes `s > K` and fails `s > 2K`. The algebraic product bound `(1-1/(3d))^(d-1) > 2/3` is rechecked. The imported prime-number estimate is not reproved, and no encoded tape scheduler is run.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3. Registered replay:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/many-axis-encoded-axis-guard
```

Passed locally as `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/many-axis-encoded-axis-guard outcome=completed`. Direct `python3 -B` and `python3 -O -B` both print `PASS_MANY_AXIS_ENCODED_AXIS_GUARD` with `band_integers=1783`. `check_research_commit.py --check-source-history` passed for base `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f`.

Not run: an encoded Count runtime, the Fiori–Kadiri–Swidinsky estimate, Lean, Docker, or the selected cold replay. The finite band scan corroborates the rational argument in `PROOF.md`. It is not a prime census.

## Open next questions

1. Write the prime queue as the odd `read_fixed` source tape `__init__` loads before `production_axis`, and include head return. Blocked by the absence of an encoded Count runtime here.
2. Restate the imported prime-count cutoff after the oddness gate. The band contains even integers. Blocked by the unreproved analytic estimate.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The ordered handoff list on #1166 is recoverable, but later DONE comments leave several numbered next tasks, so two careful readings can differ by a slot. A single current-status line on each handoff, naming the one remaining question, would make item selection stable.
